summary: In an interview with Time, which named her 2023 Person of the Year, Taylor Swift said her relationship with Travis Kelce began in July after he talked on his podcast about failing to give her a friendship bracelet with his number. She said they were already a couple when she first attended his Arrowhead Stadium game in September, and that they kept the relationship private for a while. She also discussed media attention, her effect on NFL viewership, and Kelce's own comments in WSJ Magazine.
one_line: Taylor Swift tells Time her romance with Travis Kelce began in July after his podcast remarks, before she attended her first Chiefs game.
key_facts: Taylor Swift, 33, spoke to Time after being named the magazine's 2023 Person of the Year.
Swift said she connected with Travis Kelce in July, after he said on his podcast that he tried and failed to give her a friendship bracelet with his phone number at an Eras Tour show.
Swift said they had "a significant amount of time that no one knew" before the relationship became public.
When Swift first attended Kelce's game at Arrowhead Stadium in September, they were already a couple; she said "We would never be psychotic enough to hard launch a first date."
Swift has attended five of Kelce's games so far, including one on 3 December, and often sits in the Kelce family suite.
An October game between the Chiefs and New York Jets, which Swift attended with famous friends, became the most-watched Sunday NFL show since Super Bowl LVII in February 2023.
In November, Kelce attended an Eras Tour show in Buenos Aires, Argentina, where Swift changed her "Karma" lyrics to "Karma is the guy on the Chiefs, coming straight home to me."
After the Buenos Aires show, Swift was seen running into Kelce's arms and kissing him.
Swift said she no longer lets paparazzi bother her, saying "Life is short. Have adventures" and that she is "more trusting now than I was six years ago."
In a WSJ Magazine interview published on 20 November, Kelce said Swift's intelligence has been "mind-blowing" and that he has "never dated anyone with that kind of aura around them."
Kelce said he is "not running away from any of it" regarding the scrutiny Swift faces.
The Time interview is Swift's first time publicly speaking out about Kelce.
